proposals.title: Give the node test runner its own test partition so its results count
proposals.body:
## Root cause
The node runner was added to the project's test runners, but no testPartition names it, so refresh-tests runs it and then has nowhere to cache or attribute the results. Every node test reads as missing evidence.

## Evidence
fnd-a5bb19c67699 plus this session's sighting. On HEAD 3341e17, .codeyam/editor.json has no partition with "runner": "node" (grep finds none).

## Smallest fix
Add a node testPartition to .codeyam/editor.json covering site/js/**/*.js and site/demos/**/*.js, then run refresh-tests for it so per-test-evidence.json records the node tests.

## Cost of leaving it
Every finalize reports 63+ node tests as missing evidence, which hides real gaps and pushes the session to investigate a false alarm.
proposals.reason: Two sessions (fnd-a5bb19c67699 and this one) saw all node tests pass yet record no evidence, because no partition owns the node runner.
proposals.outcome: Passing browser-side tests stop showing up as missing.

proposals.title: Node runner results are not recorded as evidence
proposals.body:
## Root cause
The editor or test runner configuration for node doesn't define a partition, so results are discarded in `refresh-tests`.

## Evidence
fnd-7b28d5a7a982, fnd-2a22dd662cdd, fnd-a396b9efb2f2, site/package.json:10

## Smallest fix
Add a partition mapping in `.codeyam/editor.json` or `.codeyam/test-cache` configuration for node tests.

## Cost of leaving it
The agent and user are incorrectly told that tests are owed or missing, triggering unnecessary full runs.
proposals.reason: The Node test runner does not have a test partition, so its results do not count towards the cache during a session.
proposals.outcome: You stop owing a full session-finalize run for features that only ran node tests.

proposals.title: Editor older than committed managed gitignore block
proposals.body:
## Root cause
The editor binary is older than the .gitignore file generated or checked into the repo, so it doesn't recognize `.codeyam/state/node-junit.xml` as a managed rule.

## Evidence
fnd-33cecc4607ed, fnd-a6b67b29cd3b, fnd-2ed5e2779d55, .gitignore:10

## Smallest fix
Update the editor binary or its internal `stage-feature` .gitignore list to include `.codeyam/state/node-junit.xml`.

## Cost of leaving it
The user and agent see cosmetic warnings on every commit, masking real issues.
proposals.reason: The editor repeatedly warns that it is older than the committed .gitignore because it does not know the rule for .codeyam/state/node-junit.xml.
proposals.outcome: You stop seeing warnings about the editor build being older than the committed .gitignore.

proposals.title: refactor -- Break up loadCircuits in site/js/simbiguity.js (156 lines)
proposals.body:
## Summary

site/js/simbiguity.js has 198 production lines against a 500-line budget; it is new on this branch. 1 of its functions are over the 150-line entity budget: `loadCircuits` (156 lines). Feature work keeps landing in this file. Splitting it along its seams keeps each concern in its own file, so the next change touches less. CodeYam generated this plan from measurements of the files a build cycle touched.

## Key Decisions

- Largest entities: `loadCircuits` (156 lines), `SimbiguityError` (7 lines).
- No shared-name groups were found; split along the largest entities instead.
- Split only along seams that are one concern; leave the rest in place.
- Behavior does not change: this is a move, not a rewrite.

## Implementation

1. Confirm the current numbers: `codeyam-editor editor size-query site/js/simbiguity.js` (the size and limit the gate judges, in under a second — re-run it after each move instead of an `audit --only` or a hand-written line counter). For the concern grouping, `codeyam-editor editor organization-report --path site/js/simbiguity.js`.
2. Move each chosen group into its own file beside `site/js/simbiguity.js`, keeping existing callers working.
3. Reconcile the glossary, test registry and evidence: `codeyam-editor editor relocate-entities --from site/js/simbiguity.js`.
4. Done when `size-query site/js/simbiguity.js` reports it within 500 production lines, or what remains is one concern.
proposals.reason: site/js/simbiguity.js has 198 production lines against a 500-line budget; it is new on this branch.
